why: Device A exported while its clock read 2027; device B with a correct clock imports and completes a lesson. Without the clamp the anti-tamper guard suppresses every day-keyed reward until the calendar catches up - a self-inflicted denial of service.

cases.why: EC-PER-15: an archive from a 2027 clock.
The device's own value had also run ahead: it comes back to today too.
An archive from the past cannot drag the device backwards either.
